sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*1612[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmcid = 'PMC5396348' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%1612%' LIMIT 5
rows: Follow-up will continue in this event-driven trial until approximately 1612 adjudicated primary-efficacy endpoint events have occurred
